title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Complex enzyme active site scaffolding by iteratively detuned catalytic guidance
items.abstract_or_text: De novo enzyme design requires sequences whose structures reproduce prescribed catalytic geometries. This remains challenging for active sites that couple multiple catalytic residues, cofactors and substrates. Here we introduce the Catalytic Guidance Engine (CaGE), which optimizes designed sequences to satisfy complex sets of functional constraints by alternating constraint guided structure prediction trajectories with sequence design, gradually fading the strength of the constraint information over cycles to nudge the designed sequence towards satisfying all the constraints. We train RF3 to accept atom-pair distances and other design conditions, and use classifier-free guidance to fade their influence over multiple design cycles. We also develop training-free motif guidance protocols which operate at inference time by directly adjusting selected atoms towards the design target geometry during diffusion sampling. CaGE improves catalytic-motif geometry across a diverse enzyme benchmark and yields sequences that recover complex target active sites in independent AF3 predictions. We experimentally demonstrate the power of CaGE by designing active enzymes with complex catalytic sites: a nonheme-iron design positions four active-site residues around an iron centre and a transition-state ligand, and a PLP-dependent design positions four catalytic residues around a PLP cofactor with multiple functional groups. Active site substitutions and a 2.7[A] crystal structure support the designed mechanisms and structures. Thus, CaGE provides a route to functional de novo enzymes with complex active sites.
items.summary_zh: 提出 CaGE，通过逐轮减弱催化约束引导结构预测与序列设计，构建具有复杂活性位点的从头设计酶，并以非血红素铁酶和 PLP 依赖酶验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文同时给出独立 AF3 预测和 2.7 Å 晶体结构支持，且完成酶活实验，是候选集中从生成模型走向结构与功能验证较完整的工作；但摘要未报告更广泛的催化性能范围和成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 从头设计酶需要其序列形成能够复现预定催化几何构型的结构。对于耦合多个催化残基、辅因子和底物的活性位点，这仍然具有挑战性。我们在此提出催化引导引擎（Catalytic Guidance Engine，CaGE），通过交替进行约束引导的结构预测轨迹和序列设计来优化设计序列，使其满足复杂的功能约束；在多个设计周期中逐渐减弱约束信息的强度，从而推动设计序列满足所有约束。我们训练 RF3 接受原子对距离和其他设计条件，并使用无分类器引导，在多个设计周期中逐渐减弱这些条件的影响。我们还开发了无需训练的基序引导协议，在推理时通过在扩散采样过程中直接调整选定原子，使其趋向目标几何构型。CaGE 在多样化的酶基准上改善了催化基序几何构型，并生成了能够在独立 AF3 预测中恢复复杂目标活性位点的序列。我们通过设计具有复杂催化位点的活性酶，实验性地展示了 CaGE 的能力：一个非血红素铁设计将四个活性位点残基定位在铁中心和过渡态配体周围；一个依赖 PLP 的设计将四个催化残基定位在带有多个官能团的 PLP 辅因子周围。活性位点替换实验和 2.7 Å 晶体结构支持所设计的机制和结构。因此，CaGE 为具有复杂活性位点的功能性从头设计酶提供了一条途径。
items.author_line: Qian, T., Wang, W., Gao, S., Muraishi, A., Zhao, B., An, D. N., Xue, F., Kazman, M., Mendoza, J., Nguyen, H., Bera, A., Kang, A., Yang, A., Dai, W., Liang, J., Wang, Y., Huang, X., DiMaio, F., Baker, D.

items.title: A generative language model decodes contextual constraints on codon choice for mRNA design
items.abstract_or_text: Synonymous codon choice affects mRNA fate and protein output, posing a challenge for mRNA technology. Design of therapeutic mRNAs requires a model that captures biological nuance from natural sequences while identifying constraints relevant to synthetic expression. We present Trias, a generative encoder-decoder language model trained on millions of vertebrate coding sequences that successfully designs mRNAs with high protein output. Trias learns codon usage rules directly from sequence data, integrating local and global dependencies to generate species-specific codon sequences that reflect biological constraints. Without explicit training on protein expression, its zero-shot predictions correlate strongly with experimental measurements of mRNA stability and protein output. Moreover, we show experimentally that novel sequences generated by Trias for a therapeutically relevant target produce more protein than existing methods, demonstrating that preferences learned from natural sequences can lead to high output from synthetic sequences. Released open source with full code and weights, Trias provides a reproducible framework for synthetic mRNA design that reveals molecular and evolutionary principles behind codon choice.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Trias 生成式编码器—解码器模型，从数百万条脊椎动物编码序列中学习密码子选择的局部与全局约束，并用于高表达 mRNA 设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在未直接使用蛋白表达训练的情况下与 mRNA 稳定性和蛋白产量实验测量高度相关，且新设计序列在治疗相关靶标上提高了蛋白产量；但验证对象和表达体系仍有限。
items.abstract_zh: 同义密码子的选择会影响 mRNA 的命运和蛋白质产量，这给 mRNA 技术带来了挑战。治疗性 mRNA 的设计需要一种能够从天然序列中捕获生物学细微差异、同时识别与合成表达相关约束的模型。我们提出 Trias，这是一种在数百万条脊椎动物编码序列上训练的生成式编码器—解码器语言模型，能够设计出蛋白质产量高的 mRNA。Trias 直接从序列数据中学习密码子使用规则，整合局部和全局依赖关系，生成反映生物学约束的物种特异性密码子序列。在没有针对蛋白质表达进行显式训练的情况下，其零样本预测与 mRNA 稳定性和蛋白质产量的实验测量高度相关。此外，我们通过实验表明，Trias 为一个具有治疗相关性的靶标生成的新序列比现有方法产生更多蛋白质，说明从天然序列中学习到的偏好可以带来高表达的合成序列。Trias 以完整代码和权重开放发布，为合成 mRNA 设计提供了可复现的框架，并揭示了密码子选择背后的分子和进化原理。
items.author_line: Faizi, M., Sakharova, H., Borrmann, H., Parsa, M. S., Lareau, L. F.

items.title: Shaping single crystals through a controlled non-classical crystallization pathway
items.abstract_or_text: The ability to program the shape of single crystals through molten-state processing has transformed the manufacturing of inorganic materials, yet this strategy is fundamentally incompatible with most organic-based crystals, which decompose before melting. Here, we show that a non-classical crystallization pathway can overcome this limitation by generating a moldable dense-liquid intermediate during the growth of peptide-based metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). By engineering a reaction environment in which precursor concentration and reagent diffusion are controlled while suppressing convection, we selectively activate a liquid-liquid phase separation process to produce a confined dense-liquid phase that can be shaped prior to crystallization. Repeated diffusion-limited chemical perturbations subsequently transform this intermediate into single crystals that faithfully preserve the geometry of the confined environment in which they form, enabling non-equilibrium morphologies inaccessible by conventional synthesis. We further show that crystal shape influences mechanical properties, demonstrating that controlling crystallization pathways provides a route to tailor function without altering chemical composition.
items.summary_zh: 利用肽基 MOF 生长过程中的致密液体中间体和液—液相分离，在结晶前塑造单晶形状，并展示形状对机械性能的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把非经典结晶路径转化为有机晶体形貌和性能调控手段，无需改变化学组成即可获得常规合成难以实现的非平衡形貌；但摘要未给出形貌尺寸范围、重复性和长期稳定性。
items.abstract_zh: 通过熔融态加工来编程单晶形状的能力已经改变了无机材料的制造方式，但由于大多数有机基晶体在熔化前就会分解，这一策略与它们根本不相容。在此我们展示，一条非经典结晶路径可以通过在肽基金属有机框架（MOF）生长过程中生成可模塑的致密液体中间体来克服这一限制。通过设计前驱体浓度和试剂扩散受到控制、同时抑制对流的反应环境，我们选择性地激活液—液相分离过程，形成一个能够在结晶前塑形的受限致密液相。随后，反复进行扩散受限的化学扰动，使该中间体转化为单晶；所得单晶忠实保留其形成时受限环境的几何形状，从而实现常规合成无法获得的非平衡形貌。我们进一步表明，晶体形状会影响机械性能，说明在不改变化学组成的情况下控制结晶路径可以成为调节功能的一条途径。
items.author_line: Thao Nguyen, João Pedro Vale, Oriol Arteaga, Annalisa Calò, James D. Nicholas, Roc Matheu, Mario Palacios-Corella, Andriu Cavegn, Maria Guix, Alessandro Sorrenti, Salvador Pané, Tiago Sotto Mayor, Josep Puigmartí-Luis

items.title: Dynamic Flow Experimentation for Data-Rich Polymer Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Growing global challenges in healthcare, energy, sustainability, and technology have motivated increased automation and robotics to accelerate material discovery and development. Continuous droplet flow chemistry has provided a solution to non-uniform mixing and transport phenomena and provides the advantages of batch reactions for screening individual reaction conditions and reagent compositions. Dynamic experimentation in flow chemistry enables the exploration of a broad design space while minimizing the use of reagents and time by continuously varying reaction parameters (such as temperature, concentration, reaction time). Here, an automated polymer synthesis platform with dynamic experimentation capabilities was implemented. The platform leveraged syringe pumps, a custom uniform irradiance photochemical reactor with tunable temperature control, inline Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and an online benchtop nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometry (NMR) at 80 MHz for automated and data-rich polymer synthesis. The combination of inline FTIR, online NMR, and offline (500 MHz) NMR enabled cross-validation between analytical techniques, and parity plots comparing data between the techniques had an R 2 value greater than 0.99 for the dynamic experiment exploring the PET-RAFT homopolymerization of methyl acrylate. Dynamic experimentation was also used to explore the copolymerization of methyl acrylate and dimethylacrylamide. The obtained rich data were used to generate accurate Gaussian process regression models for the polymerization reactions with R 2 values greater than 0.9 for parity plots of the model vs experimental monomer conversion values. The Gaussian process regression model of the copolymerization was used to understand copolymerization reaction kinetics by determining reactivity ratios under various light intensity and temperature conditions.
items.summary_zh: 构建带有在线 FTIR、在线 NMR 和可调温光化学反应器的自动化动态流动聚合平台，系统探索 PET-RAFT 均聚和共聚反应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多种分析手段交叉验证的 R² 超过0.99，并用高信息量数据训练出 R² 超过0.9 的高斯过程模型，展示了动态实验对聚合动力学和反应性比研究的价值；但当前验证集中于特定单体体系。
items.abstract_zh: 医疗、能源、可持续性和技术领域日益增长的全球挑战，推动了自动化和机器人技术的发展，以加速材料发现和开发。连续液滴流动化学为非均匀混合和传输现象提供了解决方案，同时具有批式反应筛选单独反应条件和试剂组成的优势。流动化学中的动态实验能够在连续改变反应参数（例如温度、浓度和反应时间）的同时探索广泛的设计空间，并最大限度地减少试剂和时间的使用。在此，我们实现了一个具备动态实验能力的自动化聚合合成平台。该平台采用注射泵、带可调温度控制的定制均匀辐照光化学反应器、在线傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）以及一台80 MHz 在线台式核磁共振波谱仪（NMR），用于自动化和数据丰富的聚合合成。在线 FTIR、在线 NMR 和离线（500 MHz）NMR 的结合，使不同分析技术之间能够进行交叉验证；在探索丙烯酸甲酯 PET-RAFT 均聚的动态实验中，各技术数据之间的 parity plot 的 R² 值大于0.99。动态实验还被用于探索丙烯酸甲酯和二甲基丙烯酰胺的共聚。所得丰富数据用于为聚合反应生成准确的高斯过程回归模型，模型与实验单体转化率之间的 parity plot 的 R² 值大于0.9。该共聚反应的高斯过程回归模型被用于理解共聚反应动力学，并确定不同光强和温度条件下的反应性比。
items.author_line: Dylan J. Walsh, Katharina A. Fransen, Alexander Bentley, Federico Florit, Klavs F. Jensen, Bradley D. Olsen

items.title: FREA: A Multi-Source Expert Benchmark for Reaction Feasibility Verification
items.abstract_or_text: As generative models and AI agents propose chemical reactions at a scale beyond expert review, feasibility verifiers decide which proposals enter synthesis planning. But do their decisions agree with chemists across different kinds of candidates? We introduce FREA, a benchmark of 751 reactions labeled by expert chemists under an explicit feasibility criterion, drawn from retrosynthesis model proposals, zero-yield experimental records, edits by large language models (LLMs), and five negative candidate generation methods. Our evaluation finds that no verifier leads across all sources: LLMs given only the criterion are competitive with dedicated verifiers, while forward models perform best on retrosynthesis proposals but reject most feasible edits of recorded reactions at the evaluated operating points. Looking beyond aggregate scores, both forward models perform below chance when separating infeasible alternative disconnections from feasible generated candidates. To study whether negative supervision addresses these weaknesses, we also release a corpus of over 14 million recorded reactions and generated negative candidates. In matched training comparisons, adding a mixture of generated negatives to forward training raises mean AUROC across sources, but these gains do not extend to retrosynthesis proposals. Varying the generation method further shows that the largest gain on generated candidates coincides with worse proposal screening. These findings motivate evaluating verifiers against experts across sources and designing negatives for transfer to model proposals.
items.summary_zh: 发布 FREA 基准，汇集751个由专家标注的反应，比较不同来源候选上的可行性验证器，并提供超过1400万条反应与负候选数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它揭示验证器在不同候选来源之间存在明显迁移失效，并用专家标注、跨来源评测和负样本实验拆解误差来源；但结论依赖所选专家标准与候选生成分布。
items.abstract_zh: 随着生成模型和 AI 智能体以超出专家审查能力的规模提出化学反应，可行性验证器决定哪些方案能够进入合成规划。但在不同类型的候选物上，它们的判断是否与化学家一致？我们提出 FREA，这是一个包含751个反应的基准，这些反应由化学家专家依据明确的可行性标准进行标注，来源包括逆合成模型提出的反应、零收率实验记录、大语言模型（LLM）的编辑，以及五种负候选生成方法。我们的评估发现，没有任何验证器能够在所有来源上领先：只获得可行性标准的 LLM 与专用验证器相比具有竞争力；前向模型在逆合成候选上表现最好，但在所评估的运行点会拒绝大多数对已记录反应的可行编辑。进一步超越总体分数的分析显示，在区分不可行的替代断键与可行的生成候选时，两个前向模型的表现都低于随机水平。为研究负监督能否解决这些弱点，我们还发布了一个包含超过1400万条已记录反应和生成负候选的语料库。在匹配的训练比较中，向前向模型训练加入混合生成负样本，提高了跨来源的平均 AUROC，但这种提升没有扩展到逆合成候选。进一步改变生成方法表明，在生成候选上的最大提升与更差的候选筛选同时出现。这些发现支持针对不同来源评估验证器与专家的一致性，并设计能够迁移到模型提议上的负样本。
items.author_line: Botao Yu, Bo Zhou, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Frazier N. Baker, Ziru Chen, Reza Averly, Ye Liu, Wenhao Gao, Xia Ning, Huan Sun

items.title: PharmAgent: Constraint-Aware Search with Frozen Language Models for Molecular Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular optimization must improve target activity and satisfy developability constraints within limited evaluation budgets. Classical methods require tailored rules or training to incorporate chemical instructions and property feedback. Frozen language models can condition edits on this information, but need explicit constraint control and relevant experience. We therefore present PharmAgent, a constraint-aware molecular search method driven by adaptive external state. Its Lagrangian controller translates violations in accepted states into accumulated constraint pressure, keeping this history separate from current property measurements. Structure-indexed replay complements this feedback with relevant evaluated transitions that guide subsequent proposals. As a curriculum progressively activates constraints, candidates and the incumbent are compared under the same current objective, and the accepted state determines the next multiplier update. We derive an exact identity that characterizes how accepted-state violations accumulate in the controller's multipliers. Across five tasks with five independent runs, PharmAgent achieves a summed area under the target-score curves (AUC) of 3.9208 in target-only search, improving over MOLLEO by 37.3%. With online constraints, it achieves a property-adjusted AUC of 0.7076, improving over the strongest online baseline, ExLLM, by 53.8%. These results rank first among all evaluated methods in both target-only and constraint-aware search. The online comparison covers all five baseline frameworks. The full system leads every ablation variant in target quality, property-adjusted performance, and Pareto hypervolume. All five molecular cases reach feasible final states, documenting target gains and trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PharmAgent，通过拉格朗日约束控制器、结构索引回放和逐步启用约束，在有限评估预算下进行分子优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在五项任务和五次独立运行中，目标分数 AUC 和约束调整后 AUC 均超过基线，且所有分子案例达到可行终态；但实验规模较小，尚未证明对真实实验闭环的收益。
items.abstract_zh: 分子优化必须在有限的评估预算内提高靶点活性并满足可开发性约束。经典方法需要定制规则或训练，以纳入化学指令和性质反馈。冻结语言模型可以基于这些信息调节编辑，但需要显式的约束控制和相关经验。因此，我们提出 PharmAgent，这是一种由自适应外部状态驱动的约束感知分子搜索方法。其拉格朗日控制器将已接受状态中的违反约束行为转化为累积的约束压力，并将这一历史与当前性质测量分开保存。结构索引回放机制补充了这一反馈，利用相关的已评估转移来指导后续提案。随着课程学习逐步激活约束，候选物和当前最优解在相同的当前目标下进行比较，而被接受的状态决定下一次乘子更新。我们推导出一个精确恒等式，用于刻画已接受状态中的约束违反如何在控制器乘子中累积。在五项任务的五次独立运行中，PharmAgent 在仅优化靶点的搜索中取得3.9208的目标分数曲线下面积（AUC），比 MOLLEO 提高37.3%。在带在线约束的搜索中，它取得0.7076的性质调整后 AUC，比最强的在线基线 ExLLM 提高53.8%。在目标优化和约束感知搜索中，这些结果均在所有评估方法中排名第一。在线比较覆盖了全部五个基线框架。完整系统在目标质量、性质调整后性能和 Pareto 超体积方面均领先于所有消融变体。五个分子案例最终都达到可行状态，记录了目标增益及其权衡。
items.author_line: Nihui Shao, Guanxing Chen, Jilong Shi, Zhengyang Bai, Haohuai He, Zhenchao Tang, Qiujie Lv, Yu-An Huang, Zhi-An Huang

items.title: Bridging the Evidence-to-Execution Gap:A Reflective Agent for Multi-Objective Peptide Design
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over scientific literature to devise design strategies, yet fail to reliably implement them for biological sequences. While protein generative models learn sequence patterns, they lack the capacity to incorporate literature evidence for multi-step reflective reasoning, forming an evidence-to-execution gap between scientific reasoning and sequence manipulation. We present EASER (Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection), a reflective agent bridging reasoning and sequence generation via a learned property interface of offline-trained, fixed low-rank matrices. The agent steers a diffusion generator by combining these matrices, proposing intervention hypotheses (anchors, editable positions, control coefficients) grounded in retrieved evidence, sequence context and past results. A Probe-and-Steer mechanism validates interventions and allocates samples according to predicted property responses, with outcome reflection informing subsequent decisions. Evaluated on multi-objective antimicrobial peptide design (optimizing activity, non-hemolysis and non-toxicity), explicit hypothesis formulation delivers better multi-objective performance than direct action generation under identical decision conditions. Ablation studies verify the importance of evidence retrieval, episodic history, reflection and Probe-and-Steer. Over six repeated trials, EASER obtains the highest mean hypervolume and lowest mean IGD+ on screened candidates compared with competing baselines. Our work demonstrates how an executable property interface and iterative feedback link scientific reasoning to targeted peptide sequence generation.
items.summary_zh: 提出 EASER 反思式智能体，把文献检索证据、可学习性质接口和 Probe-and-Steer 机制接入扩散模型，用于多目标抗菌肽设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在相同决策条件下，显式假设形成和反思优于直接生成，并通过消融及六次重复试验证明组件贡献；但评估仍基于筛选候选，尚未给出体外或体内验证。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能够对科学文献进行推理以制定设计策略，但无法可靠地将这些策略应用于生物序列。蛋白质生成模型能够学习序列模式，却缺乏纳入文献证据进行多步骤反思推理的能力，从而形成科学推理与序列操作之间的证据—执行鸿沟。我们提出 EASER（Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection），这是一种反思式智能体，通过一个由离线训练的固定低秩矩阵构成的可学习性质接口，连接推理与序列生成。该智能体通过组合这些矩阵来引导扩散生成器，提出基于检索证据、序列上下文和过去结果的干预假设（锚点、可编辑位置和控制系数）。Probe-and-Steer 机制验证干预并根据预测的性质响应分配样本，同时利用结果反思来指导后续决策。在多目标抗菌肽设计上进行评估时，优化活性、非溶血性和非毒性，在相同决策条件下，显式假设形成带来了优于直接行动生成的多目标性能。消融研究验证了证据检索、情景历史、反思以及 Probe-and-Steer 的重要性。在六次重复试验中，与竞争基线相比，EASER 在筛选候选物上取得最高的平均超体积和最低的平均 IGD+。我们的工作表明，可执行的性质接口和迭代反馈能够将科学推理与面向目标的肽序列生成连接起来。

items.title: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
items.abstract_or_text: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment followed model accuracy on the chemistry proposed, dropping once that chemistry moved outside the model applicability domain. Separately, a blinded evaluation asked whether the MAGI output could pass as expert work: chemists were not able to discriminate agentic proposals from held-out compounds, and judged the SAR reasoning broadly plausible yet incomplete. Together, these results position MAGI as a coordination layer pluggable into existing computational chemistry workflows. The ceiling on real projects, however, remains currently set by scorer applicability rather than by tool orchestration.
items.summary_zh: 提出 MAGI 开放模块化智能体，在九个来自三家药企的历史先导优化项目中比较 LLM 直接提案与 REINVENT4 委托路线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果把真实项目的瓶颈定位到评分模型的适用域，而非工具编排，并有盲法化学家评估；但研究是回放实验，不能替代前瞻性合成与生物测试。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体系统越来越多地协调分子设计工具，但目前尚不清楚在真实项目中是哪一层限制了结果。我们开发了 MAGI，这是一种开放的模块化智能体，能够编写目标、启动并监控优化、解释构效关系，并相应地修订策略。MAGI 既可以直接通过 LLM 生成分子，也可以将任务委托给 REINVENT4，评分服务则通过一个通用契约实现可互换。我们在来自三家制药公司的九个历史先导优化项目上进行了测试，并在固定的时间截点下重放。两条路线都产生了有效结构：LLM 提案更接近局部化学空间，并以更少的操作达到相当或更高的主要活性，而 REINVENT 探索了更宽广的化学空间。一个项目能否达到目标，取决于预测模型，而不是生成路线：当所提出的化学空间超出模型适用域后，目标达成率会随模型对该化学空间的准确性下降而下降。另一项盲法评估询问 MAGI 的输出能否被认为是专家工作：化学家无法将智能体提案与保留化合物区分开，并认为其构效关系推理总体上合理但不完整。总体而言，这些结果将 MAGI 定位为可插入现有计算化学工作流的协调层。然而，真实项目的上限目前仍由评分器的适用性决定，而不是由工具编排决定。
items.author_line: Llompart, P., Guner, L., Lai, H., Tibo, A., Xu, Y.

items.title: Optimizing the Optimizer: Language Models Discover Faster Molecular Relaxation
items.abstract_or_text: Geometry optimization is a major cost in many quantum-chemical workflows: each optimization step requires one force evaluation, and at the density-functional level that evaluation dominates the wall time. Research in this area has produced a broad range of optimization methods, and we ask whether a language model can improve on the best of them through autoresearch. An agent rewrites the optimizer itself to minimize force-call counts, restrained by two admission gates that reject premature stopping and improvements that do not generalize to unseen molecules. Starting from Sella, the fastest open-source optimizer available, the search produces AutoSella, a family of two optimizers. Both of them deliver consistent force-call reductions relative to Sella across held-out molecular benchmarks and potentials not used during the search. Most notably, at the r2SCAN-3c DFT level, the best variant requires only 40.2--77.2\% of Sella's force calls while achieving the same energy reduction, even though agent used no DFT gradients.
items.summary_zh: 让语言模型通过自动研究重写 Sella 优化器，得到 AutoSella，并在未见分子和势能上减少几何优化所需的力调用次数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 r2SCAN-3c DFT 上最佳变体只需 Sella 40.2–77.2% 的力调用即可达到相同能量降低，且通过未见基准测试了泛化；但摘要未说明不同分子类别上的失败模式。
items.abstract_zh: 几何优化是许多量子化学工作流中的主要成本：每个优化步骤都需要一次力评估，而在密度泛函理论层面，这种评估占据主要计算时间。该领域的研究已经产生了广泛的优化方法，我们提出的问题是，语言模型能否通过自动研究超越其中最优方法。一个智能体重写优化器本身，以最小化力调用次数，同时受到两个准入门控机制的约束：它们拒绝过早停止，以及拒绝在未见分子上无法泛化的改进。以最快的开源优化器 Sella 为起点，该搜索产生了两个优化器组成的 AutoSella 系列。二者在保留的分子基准和搜索过程中未使用的势能上，都相对于 Sella 持续减少力调用次数。尤其是在 r2SCAN-3c DFT 层面，最佳变体只需要 Sella 40.2--77.2 ext{\%} 的力调用次数，同时实现相同的能量降低，尽管智能体没有使用 DFT 梯度。
items.author_line: Artem Tsypin, Vladimir Deshchenya, Kuzma Khrabrov, Denis Potapov, Maxim Radchenko, Artur Kadurin, Michael G. Medvedev

items.title: Agentic campaign control for high-throughput de novo binder design
items.abstract_or_text: Progress in artificial intelligence has produced a rapidly growing ecosystem of methods for de novo protein design. With access to many specialized and often complementary tools, how does one use them effectively, especially with a finite compute budget? Here, we introduce Target adaptive Rescue-Explore-eXploit (T-REX), an agentic protein binder design framework that orchestrates multiple state-of-the-art protein generative models and structure evaluators. Over the course of a design campaign, T-REX leverages large language model (LLM) agents to reason over accumulating outcomes and decide whether to rescue promising candidates, explore alternative settings, or exploit productive routes, while a deterministic controller validates and schedules proposed actions. Across seven targets, we find that T-REX adaptively allocates its compute across methods in a target-dependent manner and achieves the highest throughput of structurally distinct hits compared to all baselines. These results suggest that adaptive orchestration can complement increasingly powerful protein design models, and we openly release T-REX to support compute-efficient binder design workflows.
items.summary_zh: 提出 T-REX，使用 LLM 智能体在多种蛋白生成模型和结构评估器之间进行目标自适应的救援、探索和利用调度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在七个靶标上以有限计算预算获得最多结构不同的命中，说明智能体编排可补充单一生成模型；但摘要未提供命中物的实验结合验证。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能的发展催生了快速增长的从头蛋白质设计方法生态。面对许多专门化且往往互补的工具，尤其是在计算预算有限的情况下，如何有效使用它们？在此，我们提出目标自适应 Rescue-Explore-eXploit（T-REX），这是一种智能体式蛋白质结合体设计框架，能够编排多种最先进的蛋白质生成模型和结构评估器。在设计活动过程中，T-REX 利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体对不断累积的结果进行推理，并决定是挽救有前景的候选物、探索替代设置，还是利用高产路线；同时，一个确定性控制器验证并调度所提出的行动。在七个靶标上，我们发现 T-REX 能够根据靶标以自适应方式在不同方法之间分配计算资源，并且与所有基线相比，获得了数量最多的结构不同命中物。这些结果表明，自适应编排可以补充日益强大的蛋白质设计模型；我们还公开发布 T-REX，以支持计算高效的结合体设计工作流。
items.author_line: Jeon, M., Song, J., Kim, J., Zhong, E. D.

items.title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.
items.summary_zh: 提出 ManifoldCache，从约束流形上的法向与切向得分分解出发，为分子构象、蛋白骨架和晶体结构等扩散模型提供无需训练和数据的加速。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 给出安全缓存边界和网络深层可认证步长的理论结果，并覆盖多类受硬约束的科学生成任务；但摘要未给出具体加速比例和各任务的保真度数值。
items.abstract_zh: 用于结构化科学生成的扩散模型必须生成满足物理、化学或生物学硬几何约束的样本，但在这些设置下推理速度极慢，每个样本需要数百到数千次神经函数评估。我们将涵盖医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质骨架设计、晶体结构预测和多视角3D场景的八个最先进模型，统一到约束流形扩散模型（CMDM）这一抽象下；在该抽象中，目标分布支撑在由外部指定约束映射定义的流形上。现有的所有加速方法在这一类问题上都失效：量化会耗尽高维体数据算子的内存；剪枝会破坏约束保真度；快速 ODE 求解器会使轨迹偏离约束流形；特征缓存启发式方法则忽视约束几何，在高噪声区域导致模式混淆。我们提出 ManifoldCache，这是首个从第一性原理出发、无需训练且无需数据、专为 CMDM 设计的加速器。其关键洞见是，条件得分可以正交分解为法向分量和切向分量：前者强制满足约束，后者在流形内导航。我们证明，噪声调度的中点是一个严格的安全缓存边界：在此之前缓存会产生有理论界限的误差，而在此之后缓存则保证有严格正比例的轨迹遭遇模式混淆；这一差距一直持续到该边界。我们进一步证明，由于得分分解通过模块雅可比矩阵传播，更深的网络模块在安全阶段允许经过理论认证的更大缓存步长。由此得到的调度不需要校准数据，也不需要训练开销。
items.author_line: Prashant Pandey, Devineni Sri Venkatraya Chowdary, Brejesh Lall

items.title: Mechanistic classification of the AAA superfamily with protein language models
items.abstract_or_text: The ATPases Associated with various cellular Activites (AAA) are a class of proteins with diverse structure-function relationships whereby conserved 3-dimensional architecture is employed in varied mechanistic contexts. While cryo-electron microscopy has revealed extensive mechanistic data, predicting how specific sequence elements dictate unique biochemical mechanisms remains a challenge. Here, we present a machine learning framework to resolve these sequence-function relationships. We established a hierarchical classification scheme based on five distinct modes of coupling ATP hydrolysis to mechanical work. Using CatFunc, a lightweight protein language model (PLM)-based pipeline, we leveraged evolutionary context from millions of protein sequences for supervised classification of AAA domains based on mechanism. We observed excellent recall of our mechanistic annotations in masked validation studies, demonstrating that domain level context is sufficient to encapsulate the various observed mechanisms. Notably, systematic misclassifications revealed a shared evolutionary and mechanistic ancestry within the rotary motor class. Applying the model to out-of-distribution proteomic datasets, we established metrics to detect unrepresented functions. Our framework provides a scalable strategy for decoding molecular function from sequence data, offering a transferable approach for other biomedically important families such as membrane transporters, G protein-coupled receptors and kinases.
items.summary_zh: 使用轻量蛋白语言模型 CatFunc，对 AAA ATPase 家族按 ATP 水解与机械功耦合机制分层分类，并检测分布外功能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把序列表示与机制层级分类连接起来，并用掩码验证和分布外蛋白组数据检验可迁移性；但摘要未报告分类规模、基线和具体召回率。
items.abstract_zh: 与多种细胞活动相关的 ATPase（AAA）是一类具有多样结构—功能关系的蛋白质，它们利用保守的三维架构来实现不同的机制背景。尽管冷冻电镜已经揭示了大量机制数据，但预测特定序列元件如何决定独特的生化机制仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一个机器学习框架来解析这些序列—功能关系。我们根据 ATP 水解与机械功耦合的五种不同模式，建立了一个分层分类体系。利用 CatFunc 这一基于轻量蛋白语言模型（PLM）的流程，我们借助数百万条蛋白质序列中的进化背景，对 AAA 结构域按机制进行监督分类。在掩码验证研究中，我们观察到机制注释具有很高的召回率，表明结构域层面的上下文足以概括所观察到的各种机制。值得注意的是，系统性误分类揭示了旋转马达类别内部共享的进化和机制祖先。将模型应用于分布外蛋白组数据集后，我们建立了用于检测未表示功能的指标。我们的框架为从序列数据中规模化解码分子功能提供了策略，也为其他具有生物医学重要性的蛋白质家族（如膜转运体、G 蛋白偶联受体和激酶）提供了可迁移的方法。
items.author_line: Swan, J. A., Hill, C. P.

items.title: GRASP: Graph Representation Learning with Assay Supervision for Molecular Properties
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular structures are abundant, while experimental bioactivity is sparse and distributed across assays. We introduce GRASP, a 93.5M-parameter graph Transformer that learns from these sources in sequence. GRASP first learns molecular structure through replaced-token detection on 1.54 billion ZINC20 molecule presentations, then adapts to sparse bioactivity across 642 ChEMBL assays. Across 23 cluster-held-out OpenADMET endpoints, GRASP achieves a mean MAE of 0.374, compared with 0.383 for CheMeleon, 0.408 for ECFP4-LightGBM, and 0.440 for Chemprop. ChEMBL adaptation reduces mean MAE from 0.407 to 0.374 and improves 21 of 23 endpoints, showing the value of intermediate bioactivity supervision. On 22 TDC ADMET tasks, GRASP gives a better point estimate than CheMeleon on 13 tasks. These results support staged molecular representation learning, where abundant molecular structure and sparse experimental measurements provide complementary supervision at different stages of training.
items.summary_zh: 提出 GRASP 图 Transformer，先在1.54 billion次 ZINC20 分子呈现上学习结构，再利用642个 ChEMBL assay 进行生物活性适配。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在23个 cluster-held-out OpenADMET endpoint 上优于 CheMeleon、ECFP4-LightGBM 和 Chemprop，并显示中间生物活性监督的增益；但仍属预印本，外部数据分布下的泛化需要进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子结构数量丰富，而实验生物活性数据稀疏且分散在不同 assay 中。我们提出 GRASP，这是一种拥有93.5M参数的图 Transformer，按顺序从这些数据源中学习。GRASP 首先在1.54 billion次 ZINC20 分子呈现上，通过替换标记检测学习分子结构；随后在642个 ChEMBL assay 的稀疏生物活性数据上进行适配。在23个 cluster-held-out OpenADMET endpoint 上，GRASP 的平均 MAE 为0.374，而 CheMeleon 为0.383，ECFP4-LightGBM 为0.408，Chemprop 为0.440。ChEMBL 适配使平均 MAE 从0.407降至0.374，并在23个 endpoint 中的21个上得到改善，显示了中间生物活性监督的价值。在22个 TDC ADMET 任务上，GRASP 在13个任务中给出了优于 CheMeleon 的点估计。这些结果支持分阶段的分子表示学习：丰富的分子结构和稀疏的实验测量在训练的不同阶段提供互补监督。
items.author_line: Srivastava, S. P., Gorantla, R., Singh, H., Chundru, S. K., Mey, A., SINGH, R. K.

items.title: ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved small-molecule drugs and 565,731 positive DDI pairs. ColdDDI evaluates pairs with zero, one, or two unseen drugs. It also annotates each interaction by whether it changes drug exposure or drug effect, and by whether the biomedical knowledge graph contains shared enzymes, transporters, or targets that can plausibly mediate the interaction. These annotations separate evidence availability from predictive dependence. We evaluate eight conventional DDI methods and 13 LLMs; for open-weight LLMs, we test five prompt patterns and use masking, drug replacement, and channel-sensitivity metrics to probe knowledge utilization. ColdDDI exposes that, in the hardest split where both drugs are unseen, the main performance divide is mediator availability. A fine-tuned 1B LLM recovers 89-93% of interactions with a shared enzyme, transporter, or target, but only 40-62% without such a mediator. More importantly, KG-provided evidence is not always used; several KG-augmented baselines change little when the shared mediator is masked or disrupted, whereas fine-tuned LLMs respond strongly to this intervention. Thus, ColdDDI evaluates knowledge utilization rather than knowledge access alone, showing where cold-start DDI models rely on mechanistic evidence and where they fail despite receiving it. Code is available at https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026.
items.summary_zh: 发布 ColdDDI 冷启动药物相互作用诊断基准，标注未知药物对、暴露或效应变化及共享酶、转运体和靶点等机制证据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它区分模型是否真正利用药理证据，而不只是获得知识；遮蔽实验显示知识图谱增强模型可能忽略共享 mediator，具有明确的诊断价值，但仍依赖 DrugBank 标注覆盖。
items.abstract_zh: 冷启动药物—药物相互作用（DDI）预测检验模型能否为没有训练阶段相互作用历史的药物识别具有临床意义的相互作用。现有基准大多报告总体边预测分数，却留下了一个关键评估问题：当模型接收分子、文本或知识图谱（KG）证据时，它们是否真正使用支持该相互作用的药理学证据？我们提出 ColdDDI，这是一个基于 DrugBank 5.1.13、可重建的诊断基准，包含1900种已批准小分子药物和565,731个阳性 DDI 对。ColdDDI 评估包含零个、一个或两个未见药物的药物对。它还根据相互作用是改变药物暴露还是改变药物效应进行标注，并标明生物医学知识图谱中是否存在可能介导相互作用的共享酶、转运体或靶点。这些标注将证据可获得性与预测依赖性区分开来。我们评估了八种常规 DDI 方法和13个 LLM；对于开放权重 LLM，我们测试了五种提示模式，并使用遮蔽、药物替换和通道敏感性指标来探查知识利用。在最困难的两个药物都未见过的划分中，ColdDDI 显示主要性能差异来自 mediator 的可获得性。一个经过微调的1B LLM 能够恢复89–93%具有共享酶、转运体或靶点的相互作用，但对于没有这些 mediator 的相互作用只能恢复40–62%。更重要的是，KG 提供的证据并不总被利用；当共享 mediator 被遮蔽或破坏时，若干 KG 增强基线的结果变化很小，而经过微调的 LLM 对这一干预反应强烈。因此，ColdDDI 评估的是知识利用，而不仅是知识获取，揭示了冷启动 DDI 模型在依赖机制证据的地方，以及尽管获得证据仍会失败的地方。代码可在 https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026 获取。
items.author_line: Jiheng Liang, Chen Zhao, Di Wu, Chenyang Bu, Yunpeng Hong, Xingquan Zhu, Yi He

items.title: Neural Kinetics: Learning Kinetics as Transport in Compositional Space
items.abstract_or_text: Complex bio-derived and fossil mixtures contain thousands of molecules whose individual structures and reaction pathways cannot be fully resolved, making conventional mechanism-based kinetic modelling impractical. A reaction network detailed enough to describe every formula-level transformation would contain far more reactions and parameters than the available data can constrain. We propose to overcome this limitation by representing mixtures directly as abundance fields on a compositional grid indexed by molecular descriptors, specifically carbon number (#C) and double-bond equivalent (DBE), and by learning a time-conditioned, chemistry-informed operator that maps the initial composition to predict a later state. The evolution rates of the chemical space are learned by a two-dimensional Fourier neural operator (FNO) acting jointly on a set of heteroatom classes, with normalized time and compositional coordinates appended as input channels. Because experimental data are limited, we enlarge the training set with synthetic trajectories generated from the measured samples, pre-train on this ensemble, and then calibrate a small subset of parameters on the measured distributions. We tested the framework on a case of oxidation of a complex hydrocarbon mixture that is tracked by FTICR-MS over sixty seconds of reaction. On an independent sample the framework, that we named NeuralKinetics, reproduced the measured endpoint class composition within a mean absolute error of approximately one percent and arranged the heteroatom classes correctly on the compositional grid. The second test was an entirely different system: litter decomposition in a peatland warming experiment, also followed by FTICR-MS but over two years. The developed operator accurately predicted the endpoint class composition of the held-out sample proving that the framework is flexible enough to adapt to diverse reactive systems.
items.summary_zh: 提出 NeuralKinetics，以碳数和 DBE 组成网格表示复杂混合物，并用二维 Fourier neural operator 学习其随时间的反应演化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在氧化烃混合物和两年尺度泥炭地分解数据上，对独立样本端点组成达到约1%的 MAE，体现跨体系迁移潜力；但摘要未说明中间时间点和不确定性校准。
items.abstract_zh: 复杂的生物来源和化石来源混合物包含数千种分子，其单独结构和反应路径无法被完全解析，因此传统的基于机制的动力学建模并不切实际。一个足够详细、能够描述每个分子式层面转化的反应网络，会包含远多于可用数据所能约束的反应和参数。我们提出通过直接将混合物表示为组成网格上的丰度场来克服这一限制，该组成网格由分子描述符索引，具体为碳数（#C）和双键等效数（DBE）；并学习一个具有化学信息的时间条件算子，将初始组成映射为后续状态。化学空间的演化速率由二维 Fourier neural operator（FNO）学习，该算子在一组杂原子类别上联合运行，并将归一化时间和组成坐标作为输入通道附加进去。由于实验数据有限，我们使用从实测样本生成的合成轨迹扩充训练集，在此集合上进行预训练，然后在实测分布上校准少量参数。我们在一个复杂烃混合物氧化案例上测试了该框架；该过程由 FTICR-MS 跟踪60秒。在独立样本上，我们提出的框架 NeuralKinetics 以约1%的平均绝对误差复现了测量到的终点类别组成，并正确地在组成网格上排列了杂原子类别。第二项测试是一个完全不同的系统：泥炭地增温实验中的凋落物分解，同样由 FTICR-MS 跟踪，但时间跨度为两年。所开发的算子准确预测了留出样本的终点类别组成，证明该框架足够灵活，能够适应多样的反应体系。
items.author_line: Paolo Guida, Naydu Zambrano Urrutia, Elia Colleoni, Shekhar R Kulkarni, Kevin Van Geem, William L. Roberts

items.title: A review on foundation models for polymer informatics
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning transferable knowledge from broad, heterogeneous data and adapting them to diverse downstream tasks, driving a growing interest in AI-accelerated scientific discovery. In polymer science, this paradigm offers a promising route beyond conventional machine learning methods that are often confined to isolated tasks and struggle to generalize under data scarcity and across heterogeneous downstream settings. Polymer foundation models (PFMs), however, are not merely general scientific foundation models applied to polymer datasets. They must address representation, generation, transfer, and evaluation challenges specific to polymer informatics. This review synthesizes recent progress in PFMs for representation learning and generative modeling, spanning models designed for polymer systems and those adapted from general foundation models. We organize this review around two stages: (1) polymer modeling as the foundation, covering representations, datasets, model architectures, and pretraining objectives; and (2) downstream applications, evaluation, and adaptation. By synthesizing recent progress, open challenges, and future directions, this review outlines a roadmap toward robust and generalizable foundation models for polymer informatics.
items.summary_zh: 综述聚合物基础模型在表示学习、生成建模、数据集、预训练、下游评估和适配方面的进展与开放问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为聚合物信息学梳理了区别于通用科学基础模型的表示、生成、迁移和评估挑战，可作为材料模型选型与数据建设的路线图；但属于综述，未提供新的实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型已经成为一种强大的范式，能够从广泛且异质的数据中学习可迁移知识，并适配多样的下游任务，从而推动人们对 AI 加速科学发现的兴趣。在聚合物科学中，这一范式有望超越传统机器学习方法；后者通常局限于孤立任务，并且在数据稀缺和异质下游环境中难以泛化。然而，聚合物基础模型（PFM）并不只是应用于聚合物数据集的通用科学基础模型。它们必须应对聚合物信息学中特有的表示、生成、迁移和评估挑战。本综述综合了 PFM 在表示学习和生成建模方面的近期进展，涵盖为聚合物体系设计的模型以及从通用基础模型改造而来的模型。我们围绕两个阶段组织综述内容：（1）作为基础的聚合物建模，包括表示、数据集、模型架构和预训练目标；（2）下游应用、评估和适配。通过综合近期进展、开放挑战和未来方向，本文勾勒出构建稳健且可泛化的聚合物信息学基础模型的路线图。
items.author_line: Yihan Zhu, Eric Inae, Yuhan Liu, Weijiang Li, Sobin Alosious, Renzheng Zhang, Gang Liu, Tengfei Luo, Meng Jiang

review.note: 按质量分不低于70筛选16项；优先覆盖分子与药物发现、材料与催化、结构与生物、方法与模型，并综合相关性、创新性、方法可信度及实验或数据验证强度排序。
